$comment: IA for the local Charter homepage clone. Derived from src/App.jsx (render order) and CLONE_SPEC.md §0.8/§1/§2 (Playwright-measured on the live site 2026-10-20). Only built routes are templates; routes the site links to but that are not built (/contact, /legal/privacy-policy) are recorded in meta.linkedUnbuiltRoutes, not invented as templates.

meta.source: https://www.charterlabs.io/ (homepage only), as cloned in this project

categories.CHROME: Site navigation and footer that frame the page; outside <main>.
categories.HERO: Page-opening block with the headline and primary call to action.
categories.FEATURES: Product capability modules, each a heading + lead paragraph + phone/photo visual with scroll-linked motion.
categories.TRANSITION: Non-content blocks whose job is to change the page's tone or pacing.

chrome.header.description: Absolute (non-sticky) 54px header, light tone: centred pill nav (Home / Overview / Company mega-menus with image cards, plus a Contact link) with a snapping highlight pill; on phone a logo + burger opening a tabbed sheet. Drops in from -100px ~1.77s after load.
chrome.header.scope: Present on the single built route, above <main>.

hero.waitlist-hero.description: Full-height light hero wrapped in a light Handoff (drifts down and darkens to 0.12 as it scrolls away): tilted hero phone image entering on load, h1 + lead paragraph line-reveals, and the expandable email waitlist pill.
hero.waitlist-hero.scope: First section of main on the single built route.

features.wallet-intro.description: Light intro block with a section gradient: eyebrow + heading + paragraph beside a phone that tilts from -60deg to -40deg with scroll, mirrored by a reflection.
features.wallet-intro.scope: Second section on the single built route.

proof.logo-ticker.description: Light-Handoff-wrapped h3 statement over an infinite marquee of four partner logos at 50px/s (no hover slowdown).
proof.logo-ticker.scope: Third section on the single built route.

features.send-slideshow.description: Light payments block: two reflected phones that settle from scale 1.5 / y -300 with scroll, then an eyebrow + h2 and a 5-slide Embla carousel (8s autoplay while >=25% visible, off-screen slides dimmed to 0.1, dots; arrows on phone).
features.send-slideshow.scope: Fourth section on the single built route.

transition.light-to-dark.description: 640px block with a sticky display-size statement while a full-viewport black overlay fades in, flipping the page from light to inverse tone.
transition.light-to-dark.scope: Fifth section on the single built route; every section after it is inverse tone.

features.finances-overview.description: First inverse block: a small caption that fades out while a reflected phone drops in from y -550, followed by h2 + paragraph.
features.finances-overview.scope: Sixth section on the single built route.

features.earn-collapse.description: Inverse block: a photo between two phones that parallax at +/-0.02 x scroll; 96px past the section top the side panels slide apart, the photo blurs/shrinks away and an overlay paragraph fades in (reversible 1s spring).
features.earn-collapse.scope: Seventh section on the single built route.

features.payroll-rise.description: Inverse block: sticky heading that a black-gradient stage scrolls over, a two-photo row (with reflection) rising from y 500, a centre statement and a three-item stat list; stacked cards on phone.
features.payroll-rise.scope: Eighth section on the single built route.

features.security-ascii.description: Inverse-Handoff-wrapped block: rounded portrait card whose ASCII-art layer and statement fade in when the section reaches the viewport top (reversible 1s spring), followed by a definition list of security points.
features.security-ascii.scope: Ninth section on the single built route.

support.faq-accordion.description: Inverse FAQ: plain h2 beside a five-item single-open accordion (0.5s spring height/opacity, plus-icon bar rotates 90deg).
support.faq-accordion.scope: Last section of main on the single built route.

chrome.footer.description: Inverse footer (#1a1a1a), sticky to the bottom at >=810px so main scrolls up to uncover it while it scales/fades in; wordmark, copyright and a four-column link nav (2x2 on phone).
chrome.footer.scope: Present on the single built route, after <main>.
